definitions.short: quiet , i.e. (concretely) a settled spot , or (figuratively) a home
definitions.full: H4494. manoach I. מָנוֺחַ noun masculine resting-place, state, or condition of rest ; — absolute ׳מ Gen 8:9 4 t.; construct מְנוֺחַ 1Chr 6:16 ; plural suffix 2feminine singular מְנוּחָ֑יְכִי Psa 116:7 (Ges § 91 l ); — 1 resting-place רֶגֶל לְכַף Gen 8:9 (J), compare Deut 28:65 ; Lam 1:3 ; Isa 34:14 (compare also מְנֻחָה Gen 49:15 ). 2 rest, repose of soul Psa 116:7 (plural abstract or intensive); condition of rest and security attained by marriage Ruth 3:1 . 3 with force of infinitive (compare Aramaic infinitive with מ prefix) הָאָרוֺן מִמְּנוֺחַ 1Chr 6:16 from the coming to rest of the ark .
